news.title: Initial release
items: Added support for exporting picture to clipboard which can be reimported even after going throuigh eg discord

news.title: Mega Update
items: Added toolbox, undo, known seeds, labels, room sizes and more

news.title: Mobile Update
items: Added support for mobile devices like ipads and phones

news.title: Changes to support workshop mod
items: MOD published on steam workshop to give option to bring up this tool based on your in game restaurant
Major internal changes to support the MOD - please let me know if you spot any issues
Exporting a tab/all tabs will trim the generated image

news.title: News Feed & Dark Mode Polish
items: Added a news feed — you'll now see release highlights like this just once, when new features drop.
For non-mobile users, select a single rotating grabber or flavoured icecream and use the [ and ] keys to cycle between alternatives
